A passive ward unlocked once the Cryptic Eye consumes 50 Totems of Undying (Spell Stage 2).

When you suffer fatal damage while the eye is equipped:
• Death is averted, leaving you at §c1.0 HP§r.
• Immediately applies §aRegeneration II§r (45s), §eAbsorption II§r (5s), and §6Fire Resistance§r (40s).
• Cleanses all active negative status effects.
• Incurs a 5-minute cooldown before it can save you again.
